command: pre-registration of the scheme's main read

metrics.deployability: the forms use the simulator (renderer or segmentation) and are an oracle teacher during practice; the token arm uses nothing but the instruction and the frozen policy's inputs

fold.round1: the chosen form on practice states 10-29 (20 episodes, real scene recorded); its successes, relabelled with the task's own instruction, fit a 1-entry KV token (experiments/f4_fold.py --source rollouts, 600 steps, lr 1e-2; tag _s1)
fold.round2: the token alone (own instruction, no form, no simulator state) on states 10-29; its successes plus round 1's refit the token (tag _s2); a task with no success in round 1 gets no token

metrics.form_rule: per task, the form with the highest success on practice states 0-9 (ledger b2_q2 tags b_q2mini and b_q2full, already run); ties -> role_open; if the best practice success is below 0.2 the task gets no form and no token (the scheme leaves it to the frozen policy)

forms.attn: the task's own instruction; the action expert's attention raised to mass 0.7 on the moved object's agent-view tokens (simulator segmentation, ORACLE), all layers, while the gripper is open (b_q2full bind@rho0.7_all_approach)
forms.role_open: the base task prototype's instruction; the new object and the base's object exchange appearance in the simulator's renderer while the policy's commanded gripper is open (ORACLE; b_q2mini role@open)

hypotheses.H1: token > zs, pooled over the tasks with a token (one-sided exact sign test on discordant paired episodes)
hypotheses.H2: form > zs, pooled over the tasks with a form
hypotheses.population: descriptive: successes of the scheme (token where it exists, else zero-shot) against zero-shot over all 14 tasks (280 paired episodes); secondary: two-level bootstrap

metrics.plan: ~/.claude/plans/i-m-interested-in-re-workshopping-quizzical-crane.md (Bind and Chain) as revised by the Q2 reads; no demonstration of any held-out task is used anywhere

population.rule: every LIBERO-90 task pi0.5 fails zero-shot (< 0.8 on states 0-4) that has a role code (a performed task of the same scene whose goal equals the task's with the moved object replaced)

metrics.scoring: init states 30-49, 20 episodes per arm and task, client bind tracking; arms: zs (all 14 tasks), form (tasks with a form), token = own instruction + the round-2 token (tasks with a token), transfer = task 49 with task 59's token (tomato sauce learned in living room 3, used in living room 1, no practice on 49)
metrics.written_before: any practice episode of this protocol (tags _s1/_s2) and any episode on states 30-49 of these tasks
